title: POV:

A megastore opened
inside the Grand Canyon.
subs: In 2031, MegaMart opened a store at the bottom of the Grand Canyon.
In twenty thirty-one, MegaMart opened a store at the bottom of the Grand Canyon.
It was four million square feet.
It had one parking space.
Customers rode mules down. Seven hours each way.
It became the most visited store in America.
Then the other companies noticed.
BurgerTown opened a drive-through on Niagara Falls.
You order at the top. Your food arrives at the bottom.
PetroMax built a gas station on a geyser.
Free car wash every 90 minutes.
Free car wash, every ninety minutes.
Then Mount Everest got a parking garage.
Nobody could ever find their car.
Scientists begged companies to leave one place untouched.
The companies agreed.
It's a single tree in Ohio.
It has a gift shop.
Tickets are $40.
Tickets are forty dollars.
The tree is not included.

hook.text: The last untouched place on Earth costs $40
hook.say: This is the last untouched place on Earth. Here's how it happened.
